questions.question: Each vowel in the word "FRETSAW" is changed to the following letter in the English alphabetical series and each consonant is changed to the previous letter in the English alphabetical series. In the newly formed word, how many alphabets are there in the English alphabetical series between the alphabet which is 3rd from the right and 1st from the right?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

"FR**E**TS**A**W"

After changing each vowel in the word "FRETSAW" into the following letter in the English alphabetical series and each consonant is into the previous letter in the English alphabetical series.

"FRETSAW" → EQFS**R**B**V**

The third letter and the first letter from the right are R and V.

Here, **three letters** S, T and U come between R and V.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All leathers are shoes.

Some bags are shoes.

Some bags are papers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some papers are leathers.

II. Some shoes are leathers.

III. Some shoes are papers.
questions.solution:
Statements:

All leathers are shoes.

Some bags are shoes.

Some bags are papers.

The Venn diagram as per the given statements:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9582d4aec747c0b67a772c53f8a3548491511615c46ed9be3b1af59a42853765.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some papers are leathers. → **not follow** (Because there is no definite relation given between papers and leathers, so it can be possible only but not definitely true)

II. Some shoes are leathers. →** Follow** (All leathers are shoes, which means some shoes are leather is definitely true)

III. Some shoes are papers. →** not follow** (Because there is no definite relation given between shoes and papers, so it can be possible only but not definitely true)

Hence, the correct answer is** "Only conclusion II follows".**

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

12 ÷ 5 - 8 × 2 + 14 = 70
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e10e3be1476caf1bd7e2e109842e7c57ce86da0c54b1b539e233e4e6a7748a44.png] 

Given:

⇒ 12 ÷ 5 - 8 × 2 + 14 = 70

(1) - and +

⇒ 12 ÷ 5 - 8 × 2 + 14 = 70

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ __**12 ÷ 5**__ + 8 × 2 - 14 = 70

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 2.4 + __**8 × 2**__ - 14

⇒ 2.4 + 16 - 14

⇒ 18.4 - 14 = 4.4

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

256 - 4 × 2 + 200 ÷ 19 = 309
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e10e3be1476caf1bd7e2e109842e7c57ce86da0c54b1b539e233e4e6a7748a44.png] 

Given:

⇒ 256 - 4 × 2 + 200 ÷ 19 = 309

(1) - and +

⇒ 256 - 4 × 2 + 200 ÷ 19 = 309

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ 256 + 4 × 2 - __**200 ÷ 19 **__= 309

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 256 + __**4 × 2**__ - 10.52

⇒ 256 + 8 - 10.52

⇒ 264 - 10.52 = 253.48

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(2) ÷ and +

⇒ 256 - 4 × 2 + 200 ÷ 19 = 309

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ 256 - 4 ×__** 2 ÷ 200**__ + 19 = 309

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 256 - __**4 × 0.01**__ + 19

⇒ 256 - 0.04 + 19

⇒ 275 - 0.04 = 274.96

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(3) ÷ and -

⇒ 256 - 4 × 2 + 200 ÷ 19 = 309

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ __**256 ÷ 4**__ × 2 + 200 - 19 = 309

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**64 × 2**__ + 200 - 19

⇒ 128 + 200 - 19

⇒ 328 - 19 = **309**

⇒ '256 ÷ 4 × 2 + 200 - 19 = 309'

Here, the equation is satisfied.

(4) + and ×

⇒ 256 - 4 × 2 + 200 ÷ 19 = 309

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ 256 - 4 + 2 × __**200 ÷ 19**__ = 309

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 256 - 4 + __**2 **____**× 10.52**__

⇒ 256 - 4 + 21.05

⇒ 277.05 - 4 = 273.05

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
